title: Add insertProfile method to DailyListViewModel
description: New method for the manage-profiles screen to add a profile, launching a viewModelScope coroutine that inserts via profileRepository.
acceptance_criteria: fun insertProfile(name: String, kind: ProfileKind, phoneNumber: String?) is a member of DailyListViewModel
It launches a viewModelScope coroutine that calls profileRepository.insert with a new Profile built from the given name/kind/phoneNumber
